subject: reasoning
question: A person is facing north. He walks 30 meters and turns to his right, walking 20 meters. Then, he turns to his left and walks 30 meters. Which direction is he facing now?
solution:
Given:

A person is facing north.

He walks 30 meters and turns to his right, walking 20 meters.

Then, he turns to his left and walks 30 meters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34b99f06350828b8bf51cb96f7bce1521d71d86ebb7798e85ae7297f97901327.png] 

Thus, facing in the north direction now.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
